notes.title: New Maps Released
notes.content:
Ahead of our big launch, we have completely redesigned all of Potemkin's classic maps, in order to make them more dynamic and fun to play on. In addition to that, we have massively upgraded these map's graphics, taking full advantage of the game's scenery function.
You can download these new maps here : https://www.reddit.com/r/Potemkin/

notes.title: Join the Beta !
notes.content:
To get some feedback from players, we have opened the game for beta!
You can now get a Steam key that will allow you to download the game for free, and experience it before anyone else! 

To get a key, email “I want a key” to wosckhelper@gmail.com and I will send you one!

There are no tricks or conditions! All we ask is that you give us feedback and that you share at least one map. Have fun! We look forward to hearing your opinions!
